newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Jan-Oct tapioca pellet exports rise 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Thai Jan-Oct tapioca pellet exports rise 13 pct.

text.p: Thai tapioca pellet exports rose 13.38 percent during the first 10 months of 1996 to 9.19 billion baht ($367 million) versus the same period last year, a commerce ministry official said on Friday.
Of the total 2.77 million tonnes of tapioca pellet exports during January-October, 2.45 million tonnes were sold to the European Union, the official said.
Tapioca starch exports during the first eight months recorded a slower year-on-year growth of 3.70 percent compared with 43.2 percent in a previous year.
Thailand exported 564,158 tonnes of tapioca starch worth 5.39 billion baht during January-August, according to the official.
But exports of modified starch showed strong growth, rising 26.19 percent to 2.32 billion baht from the same period last year, he added.

Tapioca pellets are used mostly in the animal feed industry while the tapioca starch is widely used as raw material in producing sugar and monosodium glutamate. It is also used in manufacturing glue, plywood, textiles, paper and medicines.
